## Task fix / 任务修复

Type label / 类型标签: `type:task-fix` (maintainer confirms / 维护者确认)

- Existing task ID / 已有任务 ID:
- Related issue or original PR (if any) / 关联 Issue 或原 PR（如有）:
- Problem and correction / 问题与修复:
- Verification evidence / 验证依据:
- Impact on previous scores and task availability / 对旧分数与任务可用性的影响:
- Data or permission changes (if any) / 数据或权限变化（如有）:

- [ ] Repairs one existing task; does not add a new task. / 仅修复一个已有任务，不新增任务。
- [ ] No secrets or unauthorized materials. / 无 Secret 或未授权材料。

No new Proposal required. Ask an Admin to register this fix against the existing task on the website. / 无需新 Proposal，请 Admin 在网站为已有任务登记修复 PR。
